title: Photo reverse: General Mills lab stamp, pillow-balloon note, pencil saucer sketches
description: Reverse of the comparison photograph with a General Mills Research Laboratories photo-lab stamp (Minneapolis), a handwritten note explaining that 2'x2' 'pillow balloons' photographed against a cloud background 'would give a saucer appearance when lying in a flat, horizontal position,' and faint pencil sketches of several flat saucer-like shapes; file number 1377.
